name: hubspot.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.hubspot.com scores 55 out of 100 (D). 9 checks fail now, 34 are at risk, and 39 pass. Fix first: tracking starts before the visitor chooses.

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw HubSpot (2 requests), and cookies __cf_bm on hs-banner.com, __cf_bm on hsappstatic.net, __cf_bm on hsadspixel.net, __cf_bm on hs-analytics.net, __cf_bm on…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 16 elements on /, /our-story, /careers, for example .global-nav-main-group-cta > .header-nav__ctas > .homepage-hp-nav.-primary[data-ga_nav_tree_text="Get a demo"] and .global-nav-main-group-cta > .header-nav__ctas >…
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Decline All" and reloading, HubSpot (2 requests), and new cookies __hs_cookie_cat_pref still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.

fix.title: Scripts fingerprint the browser before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, js.hs-analytics.net drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, measured which fonts are installed, and rendered a silent audio tone. Read together, these give the browser an ID that survives clearing cookies.
fix.fix: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.

fix.title: Fingerprinting continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Decline All" and reloading, js.hs-analytics.net drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, measured which fonts are installed, and rendered a silent audio tone.
fix.fix: Block the fingerprinting tag when the visitor refuses, or remove it.

fix.title: 1 JSON-LD block does not parse
fix.evidence: On /use-case/close-more-deals. A block that is not valid JSON is ignored by Google and by AI crawlers.
fix.fix: Validate each block with the Schema Markup Validator and fix the JSON.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page arrived in 338 ms
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
